title: Qwen3.8 27B QUASAR NVFP4 on two RTX 5060 Ti 16GB cards with NInfer TP2
purpose: Fastest measured dual-card Qwen3.8 27B route: MTP3 decode, full 262K context with vision, and a server-wide thinking cap that stops runaway reasoning.
caveats: Needs Blackwell (sm_120) cards: NVFP4 weights, no fallback path for older GPUs.
The TP2 fork rejects Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (MoE); use llama.cpp or vLLM for that model.
262K evidence was validated with thinking off; thinking-on requests at 150K+ prompts need a large max_tokens or they may return only reasoning.
Prefill is serialised across requests (~1,900 tok/s); a 238K-token prompt takes about 5 minutes before the first token.
Thinking-cap and effort results in docs/ninfer-tp2-qwen38.md are single-machine, one run per setting.
